import re

# Current regex in new_content (with broken backslashes)
regex_broken = re.compile(r"""
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        """, re.VERBOSE)

print("Testing '1.2.3' with broken regex:")
print(regex_broken.match('1.2.3'))

# Original regex (correct)
regex_correct = re.compile(r"""
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        """, re.VERBOSE)

print("\nTesting '1.2.3' with correct regex:")
print(regex_correct.match('1.2.3'))

# Test version that's failing
print("\nTesting '1.0.0-rc1':")
print(f"  broken: {regex_broken.match('1.0.0-rc1')}")
print(f"  correct: {regex_correct.match('1.0.0-rc1')}")
